A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] was the '''husband''' of<ref name="Chronicles" /> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman [[Sheltay Retrac/Legends|Sheltay Retrac]].<ref name="dbShel" /> The man hailed from the<ref name="Chronicles" /> [[Castle Lands]] region of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="Chronicles" /> and their wife,<ref name="Chronicles" /> a fellow [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]],<ref name="dbShel" /> was the head of the support staff for [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Chronicles" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Retrac returned from maternity leave back to her occupation and left her [[Youngling/Legends|infant]] daughter [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] in her husband's care.<ref name="Chronicles" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheltay Retrac's husband was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', written by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]] and [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="Chronicles" />
